title: Let's pass MB-820: Episode 19 - Extend ApplicationArea with custom areas

chapters.title: Introduction and concept of application areas
Creating custom application areas in setup table
Enabling and validating custom application areas
Using application areas in page extensions
Demonstrating enabled application areas in UI

features.name: Application Area extension
features.description: Ability to create custom application areas by extending the application area setup table and hooking them to experiences like premium or essential.
caveats: Requires table extension to application area setup
Must be hooked to an existing experience (premium or essential)

features.name: Enable custom area function
features.description: A function that refreshes the experience for the current company and registers the new application area.
caveats: Works on installation via install codeunit

features.name: Application area validation
features.description: Validation logic that checks if a custom application area is enabled and returns an error if conditions are not met.

features.name: Application area usage in page extensions
features.description: Ability to apply custom application areas to fields and groups in page extensions to control visibility based on the selected experience.
caveats: Spaces in application area names should be omitted when used in page extensions
